results.summary_before: This project implements a 12-bit digital-to-analog converter that produces a PWM output from a digital input. It is controlled by an external ESP32-WROOM-S3, which supplies clock, reset, enable, and the 12 input bits across the ui and uio pins. Testing involves driving the inputs with values such as 1024, 2048, and 4095 and observing the resulting PWM waveform on a wave analyzer or through the ESP32's serial output. The documentation is very brief, consisting of only a single sentence describing the design, so details of the internal implementation are not available.
